title: A Letter for the Will Revisited
author: Lena Halloran
blurb: Zephyrine Underhill, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
